 FanCode will deliver the tournament to Indian audiences, broadening access to a budding cricket league and connecting fans to the next phase of the growth of Nepal cricket.
 By Gauresh Mahadik October 26, 2026 WhatsApp Linkedin Facebook X Telegram FanCode secures exclusive digital streaming rights for Nepal Premier League season 3 FanCode , India’s leading digital sports platform, has obtained the exclusive digital broadcasting rights to the third season of the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 The competition will include 32 T20 games from October 26 to November 21 at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground located in Kirtipur, Nepal. The season will showcase a thrilling roster of global icons, such as David Warner, Andre Russell, Sikandar Raza, and Moeen Ali, together with some of Nepal’s brightest cricket prospects.
 A major achievement for the league, the International Cricket Council (ICC) has recognised every match in the third edition of the NPL as List A T20 games. This implies that players’ performances will have official statistical significance, thus improving the league’s credibility and offering increased recognition for players participating in the tournament.
 Utsav Dhungana, CAN General Manager , said, “FanCode has helped us take Nepal cricket to fans across India, and we’ve seen during the World Cup that there is a strong base of Indian fans following our progress and cheering for us. With ICC sanction, this year’s edition of the Nepal Premier League promises to be bigger than ever and I’m sure fans will follow it in large numbers.“ 
 “Nepal has witnessed growing interest in cricket, supported by a passionate fan base, the emergence of local talent and the national team’s progress in international competitions. The NPL plays an important role in this journey by bringing together domestic and international players in a competitive franchise format. We are delighted to support the League and take it to millions of cricket fans across India through our exclusive partnership,” said FanCode spokesperson.
 With the exclusive digital streaming collaboration, FanCode will deliver the tournament to Indian audiences, broadening access to a budding cricket league and connecting fans to the next phase of the growth of Nepal cricket. The collaboration enhances FanCode’s cricket offerings and demonstrates its dedication to providing a variety of global sporting events and competitions to fans in India.
 Featuring global celebrities, rising Nepali players, and the additional importance of ICC endorsement, the third season of the Nepal Premier League guarantees an exhilarating month of T20 cricket.
 The Nepal Premier League Season 3 will be available for streaming exclusively on FanCode in India from October 26 through November 21.
